correctness.rationale: Starting with the actual unit-norm chirped Gaussian and symmetric ambiguity integral, independent expansion fixes b=12 lambda tau and c=lambda tau^3-2pi nu. The Gaussian-Airy heat-semigroup identity is justified by the Airy Fourier representation plus uniqueness of tempered heat solutions, for both signs of b. Strict prefactor positivity and simple Ai zeros prove the exhaustive nodal graphs and nonzero Doppler derivative. The derivative H_j is strictly increasing with a unique positive root, proving exactly one nondegenerate fold. The coercive rescaling r=u_j^(-3/4)y and classical Ai root asymptotic rigorously establish both universal constants and the quadratic counting law. A standalone extracted checker confirms integral normalizations, 75 finite fold instances and high-index scaling, but does not substitute for the global proof.

value.rationale: The self-ambiguity function is a natural time-frequency invariant of polynomial-phase Gaussian waveforms. Beyond the classical cubic Fourier/Airy formula, this theorem classifies the complete two-dimensional real zero topology, proves exactly one fold for every Airy index, determines all horizontal Doppler level intersection counts including equality cases, and exhibits a chirp-independent sharp quadratic fold-threshold density. Such a global threshold spectrum, especially its universality despite strength-dependent individual curves, is a motivated structural result rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
